name: Excel Model Auditor
tagline: Audit Excel financial models for errors, inconsistencies, and best practices
description: Parses Excel workbooks to detect hardcoded overrides in formula rows, inconsistent formulas, circular references, broken references, sign convention errors, and structural issues. Produces a Model Health Score (0-100) and a detailed findings report with cell-level fix suggestions.

schema.label: Excel Model
schema.description: Select the Excel financial model to audit

options.label: Quick
options.description: Error cells, hardcoded values in formula rows, basic consistency (~30s)

options.label: Standard
options.description: Quick + cross-sheet refs, named ranges, circulars, sign conventions (~2min)

options.label: Deep
options.description: Standard + BS balance, CF tie-out, external links, sensitivity checks (~5min)

schema.label: Focus Areas
schema.description: Select specific areas to emphasize, or 'All Areas' for a comprehensive audit

primary.label: Audit Report
primary.description: Full audit report with Model Health Score, critical issues, warnings, and informational items

secondary.label: All Findings
secondary.description: Flat, sortable table of every finding with severity, location, description, and fix suggestion
